units.summary: For KindRecord items, loadMetadata now ignores getRecord errors and returns a metadata with the partially filled record (key only, no owner). Items are tracked even when the inventory lookup fails, including transient failures such as timeouts.
units.headline: loadMetadata now swallows record lookup errors and returns partial metadata
units.reason: Error handling changed: failures are swallowed, so items are tracked with missing owner data.
focus: Whether tracking items with an empty Owner after a transient failure (timeout, connection error) is acceptable
Caller at loader.go:54 only applies the owner if non-empty, so failed items silently keep their prior or default owner
Whether the error is still logged for non-cached paths (it is logged in GetRecord)

units.summary: New tests cover the client's failure and success caching with TTL expiry, isErrorReply with wrapped errors, and loadMetadata falling back when lookup fails. They are new tests only and don't touch production code.
units.headline: Adds tests for inventory client error caching and loadMetadata fallback
units.reason: New test-only file; no production behavior affected and fakes match real interfaces.
